settings.heading: Ancient techniques, honest healing.
settings.text: Nine Phoenix Massage brings time-tested Oriental bodywork — acupressure, cupping, and deep tissue — to the heart of Stillwater. Same-day appointments welcome.

settings.name: Traditional Oriental Massage
settings.description: Full-body acupressure and meridian work to restore balance and circulation.

settings.name: Deep Tissue
settings.description: Firm, targeted pressure to release chronic tension in muscles and joints.

settings.name: Cupping Therapy
settings.description: Traditional suction cupping to relieve stiffness and improve blood flow.

settings.name: Foot Reflexology
settings.description: Pressure-point foot massage targeting reflex zones tied to the whole body.

settings.name: Hot Stone Massage
settings.description: Heated stones combined with classical technique to melt away deep tension.

settings.name: Couples Massage
settings.description: Two therapists, side-by-side rooms, for a shared relaxation session.

settings.heading: Generations of technique, one goal — balance.
settings.text: Our therapists trained in classical Oriental massage methods, treating the body as a whole system. Every session draws on meridian-based pressure work, herbal liniments, and breathing to restore circulation and ease tension — not just relax muscles.

settings.heading: Do I need an appointment?
settings.row_content: Walk-ins are welcome, but calling ahead guarantees your preferred time. Same-day appointments are usually available.

settings.heading: What should I wear?
settings.row_content: Loose, comfortable clothing. For deep tissue or cupping sessions, we'll provide draping as needed.

settings.heading: How is Oriental massage different from a typical spa massage?
settings.row_content: We work along the body's meridians and pressure points, combining acupressure, cupping, and stretching to address root tension, not just surface relaxation.

settings.heading: Do you accept cash and card?
settings.row_content: Yes, we accept both cash and major credit cards.
